# Unique Hands Handyman Service LLC

> Family-owned handyman service in Palm Coast, Florida, run by Rob (Robert John) and Angie. 20 years of experience. Tagline: "Jack of all trades, master of many." Rated 5.0 from 20 Google reviews and 4.9 from 11 Yelp reviews. Free estimates.

## Contact
- Phone (call or text): (386) 387-1444
- Email: uniquehands386@gmail.com
- Hours: 8:30 AM to 6:30 PM, 7 days a week
- Payment: credit cards accepted

## Service area
Palm Coast, Flagler Beach, Bunnell, St. Augustine, Ormond Beach, Daytona Beach and Port Orange, Florida.

## Services
Bathroom remodels and tub to shower conversions, tile and backsplashes, flooring (vinyl plank, tile), interior and exterior painting, drywall repair and texture matching, accent walls and board and batten, decks, wood and vinyl fencing, pavers and travertine patios, pressure washing, epoxy garage floors, ceiling fans, lighting, appliance and TV installation, grab bars, gutters, dryer vents, sheds, roof and soffit repair, storm and water damage repair, rental property turnovers.
